name: Strength In God
overview: Scripture reveals that true strength comes from God alone, who empowers His people to accomplish His purposes and perfects their ways. Though even the young and vigorous may grow weary, those who wait on the Lord will have their strength renewed and will rise above challenges with endurance and vigor. God’s presence is a sure token of strength, enabling His people to serve Him faithfully and perform mighty deeds as they remain steadfast in knowing Him.
